sloka: उपविष्टाः तु ते सर्वे यस्मिन् प्रायम् गिरि स्थले ।हरयो गृध्र राजः च तम् देशम् उपचक्रमे ॥४-५६-१॥
transliteration: upaviṣṭāḥ tu te sarve yasmin prāyam giri sthale ।harayo gṛdhra rājaḥ ca tam deśam upacakrame ॥4-56-1॥

translations.english: While the monkeys were preparing to fast unto death on the plateau of the mountain, Sampati, the prosperous king of vultures, the longlived elder brother of Jatayu widely known for his strength, appeared there.
